readiness.outdated: Older than Kettu needs; update it to use it.

node.title: Needs Node.js
node.hint: It goes in Kite’s own folder: no administrator rights, nothing on your system changes.

profiles.switchHint: Takes effect from the next turn

sandbox.offNote: As today: the agent works with your rights

block.noSandbox: it has no sandbox of its own
block.notWired: it has one, which Kite does not drive yet
block.protocol: the way Kite runs it cannot go in a container yet

sandbox.networkUnsupported: This tier cannot hold it to that

cost.native: Almost free: each command starts a little slower
cost.container: Starts in about {{start}} s with its network proxy; Docker holds about {{memory}} MB while it runs
cost.drive: this project is on a Windows drive: builds and tests ran {{build}}× slower ({{native}} s → {{container}} s), searches {{search}}× slower
cost.wsl: in WSL's own disk a project runs at full speed

setup.claudeWindows: Needs `claude sandbox install` once (one administrator prompt)
setup.codexWindows: Needs Codex's Windows sandbox set up once
setup.container: Needs Docker or Podman, and the image once ({{mb}} MB)

allowed.title: Sandbox: {{choice}}
allowed.nativeWrites: Commands write only in the project
allowed.nativeReads: They read your files, except keys and sign-ins
allowed.nativeTools: File edits and web tools still ask as before
allowed.containerSignIn: None of your sign-ins: an API key Kite holds, or one made inside
allowed.gitReadOnly: Its .git is read-only: no commits inside
allowed.gitWritable: Its .git is writable: it may commit

sandbox.unsupportedBecause: This agent does not support it: {{reason}}

native.none: The agent's commands reach no network; the agent still calls its model
native.agent: The commands go out only through the exit Agent network picks for it; the agent still calls its model itself

container.model: The whole agent reaches only its model service ({{hosts}}); everything else is refused
container.agent: All of the agent's traffic goes out through Kite to the exit Agent network picks for it
